method: Second-pass screening of the revised 38 draft stems against all 1,600 current question-bank stems, using normalized character-trigram Dice similarity and a 0.42 manual-review threshold. A score is a lexical flag, not a semantic duplicate verdict.
limitations: A low lexical score does not prove semantic uniqueness; subject/topic context and manual review remain necessary.
A high lexical score is a manual-review flag, not an automatic duplicate finding.
Drafts are not inserted into original CSVs.
